lane: Mobile + content data: "Một câu cho hôm nay" (daily book quote), v1 on-device and free (proposal NEW_REFLECTION_MODALITIES_2026-11-27 section 2, batch 2; Owner approved the design and asked to start coding 27/11/2026)
goal: Add the daily book quote feature: one file per book under packages/content/data/book-quotes/ (Đạo Đức Kinh, Kinh Dịch, Suy tưởng, Kinh Pháp Cú, Binh pháp Tôn Tử) with 3 clearly-marked draft sample items each; a typed loader and a deterministic pick by local calendar date plus book; a screen "Một câu cho hôm nay" with book tabs, quote, attribution, gloss, question and three actions (ask the book guide with the quote as chat context, write in the Journal with the question as prompt, save locally); entry points on Home (card after the two-tile row), on the five book guide pages and in Explore under a new "Soi chiếu" group; saved quotes in the account's local storage, included in the data export and removed by "Xóa dữ liệu"; validate:data checks for the new files; and the Home audit that every card-looking element has a real target and an action label.
successCriteria: Five JSON files under packages/content/data/book-quotes/ follow the agreed schema, each with 3 draft sample items marked sample: true, and every personaId exists in personas-books.json and matches knowledge-briefs/index.json.
The same local date and book always give the same item (unit test), different books can differ, the Home card rotates the book by date, and reopening the screen within a day shows the same quote.

The screen shows tabs for the five books, date line, ref, serif quote, attribution with "Nilaza dịch", LỜI BÌNH, CÂU HỎI CHO BẠN, the three actions, "Các sách khác hôm nay" and the footnote, in Vietnamese and English, with accessibility labels and Android Back returning to the screen it came from.
"Hỏi tiếp" opens the existing persona chat room for the book's guide with a book_quote hand-off context (sourceLabel, userQuestion, safeSummary only); no Edge Function changes.
Saved quotes persist under nilaza.bookQuotes.saved.v1 in account storage, appear in the local export, and are removed by the existing account-prefix wipe (test).
Every card-looking element on Home has a target and a visible action label; static info does not look like a card.

validate:data checks schema, unique ids, accented vi + en, review block (status draft | reviewed | approved; a sample file must not be approved), 64 Kinh Dịch items when not sample, persona ids, and the banned-word list on gloss and question (quotes exempt); the sample files pass.

Feature id book_quote lives in one exported constant. Draft gate closed (SHOW_DRAFT_BOOK_QUOTES = false, coordinator QA round 1): only files with review.status "approved" (content review passed AND Owner approved) reach users; samples are never approved. Every entry point respects the gate: no Home card, no Explore row, no persona-page button while nothing is approved; the screen itself shows a calm empty state with a working Back.
Mobile tsc, mobile jest and validate:data pass.
untouchedSurfaces: No Edge Function, prompt, model route, SQL, migration, Admin or Supabase change; the hand-off uses the generic fields the existing chat-handoff block already reads.
useFeatureAccess and the Admin Free/Premium switch are built by another agent; this batch only exports the feature id constant.
PLAN.md is not edited in this branch (the coordinating agent updates it).
Real quote content (60 per book, 64 hexagrams) comes from the content branches and nilaza-content-review; the sample items here are placeholders marked sample.
Bói Kiều and Rune tiles are not added; Explore's Soi chiếu group has one item and a documented extension point.

impact.entryPoint: Home card "MỘT CÂU CHO HÔM NAY" after the sky/sign tile row; a button on the five book guide detail pages; Explore → Soi chiếu → Một câu cho hôm nay. New Screen value bookQuote with its own return screen; Android Back and the on-screen back return there.
impact.dataWrite: Saved quotes (id, book, date key, saved time and the shown text snapshot) in account-scoped AsyncStorage key nilaza.bookQuotes.saved.v1 through the existing createAccountStorage; guests keep them in memory only. Included in buildLocalExport; removed by the existing account-prefix clear. No Supabase writes.
impact.backendContract: No new API. "Hỏi tiếp" reuses openChat(room, personaId, handoffContext) and the existing persona chat Edge Function, which reads only sourceLabel, userQuestion and safeSummary from the hand-off context; sourceType book_quote is a new client-side enum value used in local events.
impact.adminVisibility: None in v1. Usage events book_quote_opened / book_quote_saved / book_quote_chat_opened / book_quote_journal_opened go to the existing local recordEvent; Admin gating comes with the later Free/Premium switch (feature id book_quote).
impact.privacySafety: Quotes are curated public-domain text; gloss and question pass the banned-word check (no prediction, no luck, no instructions). Saved quotes are not sensitive and never leave the device except through the user's own export. No journal or chat content is read by the feature.
impact.observability: Local usage events above; validate:data reports book-quote schema and banned-word failures in CI.
impact.rollback: Remove the Home card, Explore group and guide button props (or revert the commit); saved data stays harmless under its own key and is still wiped by Xóa dữ liệu.

canonicalContracts: packages/content/data/book-quotes/*.json schema (schemaVersion 1, as given by the coordinating agent)

managerTestPath: Bản hiện tại: nội dung mẫu chưa được duyệt nên người dùng KHÔNG thấy tính năng — Hôm nay không có thẻ "Một câu cho hôm nay", Khám phá không có nhóm Soi chiếu, trang người dẫn sách không có nút. Khi một sách được duyệt (review.status = approved sau content review và Owner duyệt): Hôm nay → thẻ "Một câu cho hôm nay" → câu trích, Lời bình, Câu hỏi → "Lưu câu này" → Back của Android về Hôm nay → mở lại: vẫn câu cũ; Trò chuyện → người dẫn sách đó → nút "Một câu cho hôm nay"; Khám phá → Soi chiếu; Hồ sơ → Xuất dữ liệu có mục bookQuotesSaved.
residualRisk: Feature is invisible to users until real content is reviewed and Owner-approved; sample quotes stay draft. Device behaviour (Back, TalkBack, large text) is not verified on a phone; the pick changes when a book's item list grows, so the first day after a content update may show a different quote than earlier that day.
